service.name: Blues and rock band
service.serviceType: Blues and rock covers for private and corporate events
service.description: Blues, classic rock and original material fronted by Tony Medina, booked from solo voice and guitar up to a four piece, for private and corporate events in Denver, the Front Range and the Colorado mountain corridor.

faqs.a: Blues and the rock and roll that came out of it, plus his own songs. The covers run from Freddie King and B.B. King through the classic rock of the seventies and the alternative rock of the nineties, and the footage on this page is him playing them. A set is built against your run of show and read song by song on the night.

faqs.q: How small can this booking be?
faqs.a: One player. Solo is a voice and an acoustic guitar, and it is a real booking rather than a minimum to work around: welcome drinks, a patio evening, a rehearsal dinner or a long dinner service where guests need to hear each other. It is the smallest live booking on the roster.

faqs.q: Will it fill a dance floor?
faqs.a: At trio and four piece, yes. Voice and guitar over bass and drums, with a second guitar or keys on top at the four piece, playing blues and rock covers a crowd already knows. Dinner sits at 65 to 72 dBA at the nearest table and a floor runs 88 to 95, and the band moves between the two on cue.

faqs.q: Does he play originals at a private event?
faqs.a: Only if you want them. The default set for an event is covers, because guests dance to what they recognise. He has a published catalogue of his own songs and they can sit inside the set where a night has space for them, which is worth asking about for a listening crowd rather than a dancing one.

video.name: Tony Medina live: blues guitar and vocals for private events in Denver
video.description: Tony Medina and a second player on the Freddie King blues standard Going Down: the voice and the guitar he brings to a welcome drinks set, a rehearsal dinner or an office party.
